subject: Request: erase prompts, outputs, and logs — deletion confirmation workflow
messages:
From: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni@vaultapps.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@vaultapps.io
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data erase request: prompts/outputs/logs for VaultApps trial org

Hi Jonas,

Can you help with a full data erase for our VaultApps trial org? We need all user-submitted prompts, generated outputs, and inference logs (including KV cache metadata and request traces) removed from Redwood-hosted storage and from any dedicated workloads associated with our account.

We also need an auditable confirmation of what was removed, timestamps, and the storage locations involved. This is to satisfy an internal compliance ask — we need the confirmation and the audit package by EOD Monday (2026-11-01).

Account details: VaultApps - trial-org-5274
Primary contact: Eleni Papadopoulos / security@vaultapps.io

Please confirm the scope and next steps. If you need a signed deletion request form, tell me and I'll get that over.

Thanks,
Eleni
Security Lead
VaultApps

[attachment: request-identity-vaultapps.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni@vaultapps.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data erase request: prompts/outputs/logs for VaultApps trial org

Thanks Eleni — we can handle this. Quick clarifying questions before we proceed:

- Scope: confirm you want all prompts, model outputs, and inference logs across hosted API and any Dedicated pools tied to trial-org-5274.
- Time window: delete all historical data since account creation (please confirm if you need to preserve any specific transcripts).
- Proof: do you have an authorized deletion request (signed PDF) or should we accept this email + ID verification from security@vaultapps.io?

I'm attaching a short "erase playbook" (draft) that outlines steps we take and expected timeline. I'll loop in Ops to execute once we have explicit scope + authorization. Planning estimate: 24-72 hours depending on replication windows.

Next steps I'd like to take:
1) You reply with confirmation of scope and attach signed request if available.
2) We perform a scoped dry-run on metadata and share an inventory of buckets/indices to be removed.
3) After your approval, we schedule the deletion window and provide an audit package.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

[attachment: erase-playbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data erase request: initial ops checklist

Jonas / Monica — tagging ops. I reviewed the playbook; below are the operational checks and the order we'll run things in. Rishi, please action when authorized.

Operational checklist (high level):
- Verify account ID mapping (trial-org-5274) across config service and Dedicated pools.
- Snapshot list of S3 buckets, Redis/KV namespaces, and logging indices for retention records.
- Create retention boundary: only remove objects tagged as belonging to trial-org-5274.
- Run deletion in two phases: 1) 48-hour soft-delete + tombstone removal on metadata indices, 2) physical wipe for S3 objects (expunge) and KV namespaces.
- Post-run: collect audit-metadata, sign with Redwood KMS, and prepare redacted audit package for VaultApps.

Authorization required: signed deletion request (company letterhead) or explicit approval from security@vaultapps.io. If we have email authorization, ops will still ask for a short attestation from legal before full expunge.

Estimated timing: dry-run inventory within 6 hours of authorization; full expunge targeted within 48 hours after authorization (barring cross-region replication delays).

Attaching internal deletion SOP that Rishi should follow.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Security

[attachment: deletion-sop.md (text/markdown)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data erase request: ops run and status

On Sun, Oct 31, 2026 at 11:30 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jonas / Monica — tagging ops. I reviewed the playbook; below are the operational checks and the order we'll run things in. Rishi, please action when authorized.

Authorization received from VaultApps (security@vaultapps.io) at 2026-10-31T19:40:00Z. I kicked off the dry-run inventory immediately. Inventory summary:

- S3 buckets: s3://redwood-prod-logs/trial-org-5274, s3://redwood-model-cache/trial-org-5274
- KV namespaces: kv://cache/trial-org-5274 (two shards)
- Indices: logs-vaultapps-5274 (3 indices)

Dry-run actions: tagged 3,842 objects for deletion. No cross-tenant references found.

Executed expunge window on 2026-11-01T05:12:00Z (started) — completed physical expunge at 2026-11-01T12:04:00Z for all targeted objects and KV namespaces. KV shards zeroed and tombstones applied to indices.

Audit artifacts generated: deletion-ticket=DEL-2026-1101-VA5274; signed-audit-checksum=sha256:9a3f2b...
Attached: deletion-report-20261101.json (redacted per policy). Audit folder saved to internal Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-delete-audit (redwood-internal limited access).

Rishi
Senior Infra Ops Engineer

[attachment: deletion-report-20261101.json (application/json)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni@vaultapps.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data erase request: completion and confirmation

Eleni —

Thanks for the authorization. This is to confirm we completed the requested erase for VaultApps (trial-org-5274). Summary below and attached audit package.

What we removed:
- All prompts and generated outputs associated with trial-org-5274 (hosted API + Dedicated pools).
- Inference logs and request traces tied to the account.
- KV cache namespaces and model-cache objects listed in the dry-run inventory.

Audit artifacts and IDs:
- Deletion ticket: DEL-2026-1101-VA5274
- Signed checksum: sha256:9a3f2b...
- Internal audit folder (redwood-internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-delete-audit
- Redacted audit package for VaultApps (download): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Zx-erase-audit-copy/view

Timeline:
- Dry-run inventory: 2026-10-31T19:50:00Z
- Expunge start: 2026-11-01T05:12:00Z
- Expunge completion: 2026-11-01T12:04:00Z

Compliance notes: physical removal completed; replication windows to EU region were checked and no residual objects remain. Per our policy, we retain a signed audit checksum (not the raw prompts/outputs) for 7 years for legal traceability — this is the minimal metadata required for audit and is included in the redacted package. If VaultApps prefers full deletion of the signed checksum record, we can escalate to Legal and provide a special SLA (note this will remove the only trace we keep for regulatory reasons).

Please reply to confirm receipt and whether you need a DocuSign confirmation or an expanded audit pack.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

[attachment: deletion-report-20261101.json (application/json); deletion-certification-VA5274.pdf (application/pdf)]
